context.transcript:
Hello, this is Mustafa Hammam returning your call.
Thanks for getting back to me, Mustafa.
You helped me with the legal work to set up my furniture store.
Now I'd like to hire an accountant to take over the finances for the business, but I'm not sure how to select one.
Oh, I'm often asked to make these kinds of professional connections for my clients.
I'll prepare a list of names and send it to you later today.
Excellent.
One thing, though, I'll be away at a conference next week, but if you should have any questions while I'm away, one of the other lawyers can assist you.
Okay, thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是Mustafa Hammam，回电给您。
谢谢你回复我，Mustafa。
你帮我处理了设立家具店的法律事务。
现在我想聘请一位会计师来接手公司的财务，但我不知道如何选择一位。
哦，我的客户经常让我建立这类专业的联系。
我会准备一份名单，并在今天晚些时候发给您。
太棒了。
不过有一件事，我下周要去参加一个会议，但如果我不在的时候有任何问题，其他律师可以帮到你。
好的，谢谢。
